description: This file defines a PHP class 'Screen' within a human resource management system. The class models a screen or UI component with attributes such as name, module, URL, permissions, and optional menu configurator. It includes methods for constructing instances from arrays, and for retrieving attribute values.

classes.name: Screen
classes.description: Represents a UI screen with properties such as name, module, URL, permissions, and optional menu configurator within the OrangeHRM installer utility.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Screen object with provided name, module, URL, permissions, and optional menu configuration.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a new Screen instance from a name and an array containing data for module, URL, permissions, and optional menu configurator.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the screen.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with the screen.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the screen.

methods.name: getMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Returns the menu configurator if set, otherwise null.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns an array of permission objects associated with the screen.
